messages:
Jamie (DevEx PM): Quick async check — changelog freeze at 10:00 PT tomorrow and SDK RC cut at 14:00 PT. Posting the preflight checklist here. Please confirm owners for any outstanding blockers.
Raj (SDK): Ack. I'll own the v1.5.0-rc branch readiness. Quick Q: are we gating on the telemetry PR #512?
Maya (SampleApps): Heads-up — sampleapp-node is blocked by internal-lib PR 342 (native build failure). I'm triaging but need a second pair. @Raj can you glance?
Raj (SDK): On it. I pulled the build locally, failing in the C++ shim. Will add a diagnostic log later today.
Sophia (Docs): Docs cut: I need final CLI flags and changelog bullets by 09:30 PT tomorrow. If any SDK surface changes, ping me now — otherwise I'll snapshot current docs for the RC.
Ava (QA): Test matrix: I'll run the smoke matrix against rc artifacts once Liam publishes them. ETA for publish?
Liam (Release Eng): Plan is to publish RC artifacts at 14:15 PT assuming all checks pass. If CI is flaky we'll hold — need explicit go/no-go by 14:00.
Ken (CI Bot): CI status: main pipeline green, integration pipeline 2/6 failing (flaky e2e). Failing tests: conversation-flow and grpc-timeout. Links: https://ci.redwood/12345
Jamie (DevEx PM): Thanks Ken. Raj, if telemetry PR is necessary for changelog accuracy we can delay, otherwise list as post-rc change. Maya + Raj, please pair on the native build — assign owners here.
Raj (SDK): Assigning to self + Maya. I'll open a follow-up PR if I need to push a patch.
Maya (SampleApps): Thanks. Noted. If we can't fix by 13:30 PT we should consider removing the sample app from the RC and ship it in a follow-up.
Sophia (Docs): If sampleapp gets removed from RC, please tell me — I'll update docs and note it in the changelog under "excluded components".
Ava (QA): For the flaky e2e, I'm re-running isolated runs now. If green twice, we'll consider them unstable flakes and proceed with a risk note.
Ken (CI Bot): Re-run started. Results expected in ~12 minutes.
Liam (Release Eng): To be explicit: required for RC = green unit + green integration (excluding known flaky but documented tests) + artifacts published. Anything else is optional.
Jamie (DevEx PM): Ownership summary: Raj — SDK branch readiness + telemetry check; Maya — sampleapp triage; Sophia — docs snapshot + changelog bullets; Liam — publish RC; Ava — smoke matrix; Ken — CI observability. I’ll ping infra if CI hangs.
Raj (SDK): FYI I've created a short debug branch at https://git.redwood/sdks/sdk-native-debug with logs. I expect a small patch within 60m.
Maya (SampleApps): Patch applied locally, builds succeed with Raj's tweak. I'll run sampleapp smoke and push an acceptance PR in ~30m.
Ava (QA): Sampleapp smoke passed locally. I'll run pipeline after PR lands.
Ken (CI Bot): Integration pipeline now 4/6 passing; conversation-flow flaky re-ran green twice.
Liam (Release Eng): Looks good. Unless something new pops up, I'll publish at 14:15 PT. Please post final go/no-go in this thread by 14:00 PT.
Jamie (DevEx PM): Final call window: post any last blockers by 13:45 PT. If you need a rollback plan, post steps here.
Raj (SDK): No further blockers from SDK side. Changelog bullet for telemetry: "added optional telemetry opt-in flag to CLI (--telemetry)" — Sophia can expand.
Sophia (Docs): Got it. I'll add that bullet and the CLI flag example.
Maya (SampleApps): PR created: https://git.redwood/sampleapps/pull/789 — sampleapp included.
Ava (QA): Sampleapp pipeline green.
Ken (CI Bot): All required pipelines green.
Jamie (DevEx PM): Go ✅ — proceeding to RC publish. Thanks everyone. I'll update the release playbook with final owner notes.
Liam (Release Eng): Publishing now. Artifact URLs will be posted in #releases when complete.
Ken (CI Bot): Release artifact upload: https://artifacts.redwood/rcs/v1.5.0-rc
Jamie (DevEx PM): Closing loop: post-mortem note: if any regressions surface, tag me and @Liam. Thanks team :tada:
